title.sr: Utisak klijenta - od slanja do odobravanja (telefon)
title.en: A customer review - from sending to approval (phone)

intro.sr: Posetilac ostavlja utisak na početnoj strani, a administrator ga u „Testimoniali“ proverava i odobrava; tek tada postaje javan. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: A visitor leaves a review on the home page, and an administrator checks and approves it in “Testimoniali”; only then does it become public. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
